terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms explain the rules that apply when using the BX-Connect community platform.

sections.title: 1. Purpose of the platform
sections.body: BX-Connect is a Bx-Jeunes Impact ASBL platform designed to support young members, mentors, administrators and partners. It manages accounts, groups, activities, registrations, projects, messages, notifications and partner support.

sections.title: 2. Account creation and security
sections.body: Users must provide accurate information and keep their credentials confidential. Activity performed through an account is presumed to come from its owner. Suspected unauthorised access must be reported promptly.

sections.title: 3. Roles and access
sections.body: Features depend on the assigned role: member, mentor, administrator, super administrator or partner. Attempting to access another role’s, group’s or user’s restricted data is prohibited.

sections.title: 4. Expected conduct
sections.body: Content and exchanges must remain respectful, lawful and relevant to the community. Harassment, discrimination, impersonation, illegal content, privacy violations, abusive advertising and attacks against the platform are prohibited.

sections.title: 5. Published content
sections.body: Users remain responsible for the texts, comments, projects and messages they publish and confirm they hold the necessary rights. BX-Connect may hide or remove clearly unlawful, dangerous or non-compliant content.

sections.title: 6. Suspension and deletion
sections.body: An account may be limited, suspended or disabled following a breach, security risk or legitimate request. Users may request deletion, subject to information that must be retained for legal obligations or the defence of rights.

sections.title: 7. Availability and liability
sections.body: BX-Connect aims to provide a reliable service but cannot guarantee permanent availability. Within the limits of Belgian law, the association is not liable for reasonable interruptions, third-party services or indirect damage.

sections.title: 8. Applicable law and contact
sections.body: These terms are governed by Belgian law. Questions may be sent to contact@bxconnect.be. An amicable solution will be sought before legal proceedings.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how BX-Connect processes personal data in line with GDPR principles.

sections.title: 1. Data controller
sections.body: Bx-Jeunes Impact ASBL, Brussels, Belgium, is the controller for processing performed through BX-Connect. Data protection contact: contact@bxconnect.be.

sections.title: 2. Data processed
sections.body: We may process identity and contact details, role, language, registration date, group information, activities and registrations, projects and participation, messages, notifications, financial support, technical logs and evidence of legal acceptance.

sections.title: 3. Purposes
sections.body: Data is used to create and secure accounts, manage roles, groups, activities, registrations, projects, messages and notifications, process partner support, provide assistance, prevent abuse and produce internal statistics.

sections.title: 4. Legal bases
sections.body: Depending on the processing, the legal basis is performance of the requested service, consent, legal obligations or the association’s legitimate interest in securing and improving the platform.

sections.title: 5. Recipients and processors
sections.body: Only authorised people can access data according to their role. Technical providers may support hosting, communications or payments under appropriate contractual safeguards.

sections.title: 6. Retention and security
sections.body: Data is retained for as long as needed for the account and relevant activities, then deleted or anonymised unless a legal duty applies. Access controls, authentication, logging and backups reduce risks.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
sections.body: You have rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction and objection, and a right to portability where applicable. Consent may be withdrawn without affecting earlier lawful processing.

sections.title: 8. Exercising your rights
sections.body: Send requests to contact@bxconnect.be with your identity and request. You may also complain to the Belgian Data Protection Authority: www.dataprotectionauthority.be.

notices.title: Legal notice
notices.intro: Information about the publisher and operation of the BX-Connect service.

sections.title: Publisher
sections.body: BX-Connect is published by Bx-Jeunes Impact ASBL, an association established in Brussels, Belgium. General contact: contact@bxconnect.be.

sections.title: Publication responsibility
sections.body: Editorial responsibility is held by the administration of Bx-Jeunes Impact ASBL.

sections.title: Hosting and technical services
sections.body: Final production hosting details, including the provider’s address and contact information, must be published before the service opens publicly.

sections.title: Intellectual property
sections.body: The BX-Connect brand, interface, original texts and graphics are protected. Reuse beyond personal use requires permission. Users retain rights to the content they publish.

sections.title: Reporting
sections.body: Illegal content, security concerns and personal-data requests may be reported to contact@bxconnect.be.
